meta.title: Ondra recall evaluation
meta.description: Decides whether a parameter change made recall better or worse: 20-40 real questions (including paraphrases and fabricated ones), reporting recall@1/@3/@5 and MRR, with the report written to disk alongside a parameter snapshot. It measures only, never tunes; ground truth resolves by text fingerprint (survives a rebuilt database); undecidable cases are excluded rather than scored zero.
